snippet.title: G Squad: Handcrafted Strategy Autobattler
snippet.description: Play as the G Squad as they battle their way back to the capital in this handcrafted strategy autobattler with roguelite and RPG elements by solo dev Vigorous Games. Designed to scratch the strategy itch without the spreadsheets.
